geometryBasis: Mapped retaining arc, inner and outer cavea walks, axial stair and municipal archaeological measurements provide the theatre geometry. The stage deck, irregular seating and remaining columns follow the five cleared exterior images.
sectionBasis: The 1996 excavation report gives 16 lower rows with 0.8 m treads and 0.4 m rises. The municipal museum gives a 43.60 m stage span. Upper surviving seat elevations and foundation contacts are photographic estimates in the unchanged source field.
